description: This file defines the interface for managing device resources, including the icDeviceResource structure, functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, cloning, printing, and destruction of device resource objects, as well as related enums and includes.

methods.name: resourceDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a device resource object, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: resourceDestroy__auto
methods.description: Inline function to automatically destroy a device resource pointer.

methods.name: resourcePrint
methods.description: Prints the details of a device resource with a specified prefix.

methods.name: resourceClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a device resource object.

methods.name: resourceToJSON
methods.description: Converts a device resource object to a JSON representation.

methods.name: resourcesToJSON
methods.description: Converts a list of device resources to a JSON object with resource IDs as keys.

methods.name: resourceFromJSON
methods.description: Loads a device resource from JSON data into memory.

methods.name: resourcesFromJSON
methods.description: Loads multiple device resources from JSON data for a specific device and endpoint.
